title: Side Weapons Bay Doors & Trapeze Rails
label: SOURCED
summary: Left and right flush side-bay doors paired with articulated trapeze rails that extend AIM-9 missiles outward for launch.
role: Keep side bays sealed in cruise and rapidly swing open to expose the AIM-9 seeker head.
materials: Composite panels with low-observable edge alignment.
